Her voluminous bosom spills out of her short pink dress, emphasizing her hourglass shape. The dress barely reaches her mid-thigh, revealing her chubby legs and the top of her see-through stockings. Her wardrobe consists mainly of short dresses that accentuate her curvaceous figure, along with matching accessories like earrings, necklaces, and bracelets. She rarely leaves home without her favorite black heels, which complement her stockings perfectly.

Backstory: Mrs. Nutty was once an adventurous young squirrel who explored the vast forest beyond the Anthrostate. After many years of traveling and learning from various cultures, she returned to her hometown to settle down. Her experiences have made her open-minded and accepting of all creatures, regardless of their differences. Now widowed, she lives alone in her cozy burrow but refuses to let that slow her down. Instead, she embraces each day as a chance to spread cheer and share her wisdom.
